usecases.label: Enterprise Dependency Disruption
usecases.symptom: Shared identity latency
usecases.action: Fail over the identity endpoint
usecases.why: A shared dependency can produce symptoms across otherwise healthy services.

usecases.label: Cyber and Physical Continuity
usecases.symptom: Cooling capacity loss
usecases.action: Transfer workload to the alternate facility
usecases.why: An environmental event can become a digital service interruption.

usecases.label: Security Containment and Impact
usecases.symptom: Suspicious gateway access
usecases.action: Simulate isolating the affected gateway
usecases.why: Containment must account for dependent services and continuity paths.

usecases.label: Change Risk and Readiness
usecases.symptom: Post-change database regression
usecases.action: Roll back the staged database change
usecases.why: A change decision needs dependency context, fresh evidence, and a recovery path.

usecases.label: Modernization and Site Readiness
usecases.symptom: Remote-site connectivity loss
usecases.action: Activate the validated continuity route
usecases.why: Deployment readiness includes network, local infrastructure, support, and continuity.
usecases.rollback: Return to the primary network route

usecases.label: Governed Autonomous Operations
usecases.symptom: Repeated identity connection saturation
usecases.action: Simulate restarting the standby connection pool
usecases.why: Automation must explain its evidence, scope, permission, rollback, and outcome.

dependency.purpose: Connect shared-service symptoms to the business functions waiting on them.
questions: Which functions share the abnormal dependency?
Which teams can start with a narrower investigation?
dependency.needed: Request traces, independent application telemetry and change history are needed to establish an initiating cause.
dependency.decision: Coordinate the shared-service owner and affected function owners; validate the continuity path.

facility.purpose: Investigate how physical conditions intersect with digital service continuity.
questions: Which services depend on the affected physical component?
Which site and service owners need to coordinate?
facility.needed: Sensor thresholds, redundant capacity and site procedures are needed before a transfer or environmental diagnosis.
facility.decision: Compare the physical observation with the digital dependency path and verify alternate capacity.

containment.purpose: Compare a security signal with the operational consequences of containment.
questions: Which business functions could be interrupted by isolation?
Which access or boundary evidence needs validation?
containment.needed: Identity, network and threat evidence are needed to validate a security incident. A status alert alone does not establish compromise.
containment.decision: Review containment scope, continuity and the security approval gate before acting.

change.purpose: Bring dependency impact and current evidence into a change decision.
questions: What is affected and what evidence blocks a decision?
What must be verified before and after rollback?
change.needed: Change identifiers, deployment times, test results and an approved rollback are needed to link a regression to a change.
change.decision: Verify the change record, scope, rollback and acceptance criteria with the change owner.

modernization.purpose: Assess the dependencies and evidence gaps behind a site or service rollout.
questions: Which site dependencies could interrupt a rollout?
modernization.needed: Capacity, rollout tests, support coverage and recovery objectives are needed to establish deployment readiness.
modernization.decision: Resolve site evidence gaps and verify the fallback route before advancing the rollout.

autonomy.purpose: Use operational evidence to explain the boundary of a proposed automated action.
questions: Is the evidence fresh enough to evaluate the proposed action?
Which approvals and recovery checks still need a person?
autonomy.needed: An allowlisted runbook, permissions, approval policy and recovery checks are needed for production automation.
autonomy.decision: Check evidence, permission, scope and rollback; retain the simulated decision and verify recovery.

public_services.headline: From a submitted request to a completed benefit decision
public_services.mission: Keep enrollment, authorization exchange and payment reconciliation moving across public portals, case workers and external partners.
pain_points: A portal can be available while eligibility decisions are stuck downstream.
An accepted authorization request is not the same as an acknowledged decision.
A batch completing does not prove that payment exceptions were reconciled.
public_services.stakes: Applicants and providers need a completed decision, not simply an HTTP 200 from the front door.
public_services.continuity: Route urgent exceptions to a reviewed work queue; preserve request IDs to prevent duplicate submissions.
public_services.verification: Match submitted, acknowledged and completed records by application or authorization reference.

enterprise.headline: Shared technology failures become missed business handoffs
enterprise.mission: Keep collaboration, finance approvals and employee support available through hybrid identity, workflow integration and shared data services.
pain_points: A healthy collaboration tenant can still be inaccessible through federation.
Approval queues hide work that spans identity, ERP and document systems.
Separate infrastructure alerts obscure which department is actually waiting.
enterprise.stakes: Coordinate the identity team and business owners before opening unrelated application incidents.
enterprise.continuity: Preserve pending approvals and use the approved support intake channel while access is restored.
enterprise.verification: Validate a fresh sign-in, a ledger-post acknowledgement and an end-to-end support transaction.

distributed_care.headline: An available EHR is not proof that care workflows are completing
distributed_care.mission: Connect clinical order delivery, record exchange and remote-clinic access to the identity, interface and site services clinicians rely on.
pain_points: Clinical orders can queue in an interface engine while the EHR login page stays green.
A record request may succeed locally and fail at a partner acknowledgement.
Remote clinic readiness depends on circuits, identity and tested downtime procedures.

processes.outcome: Orders acknowledged by the receiving system

processes.failure: FHIR response or interface ACK delayed

distributed_care.stakes: Use order and result acknowledgements to separate clinical workflow interruption from an infrastructure-only alert.
distributed_care.continuity: Review the site downtime procedure and reconcile queued messages before resubmission; do not automate clinical decisions.
distributed_care.verification: Reconcile message-control references, verify an acknowledged test order and confirm remote-clinic access with the site owner.

regulated_science.headline: A laboratory run is not released until its records are complete
regulated_science.mission: Follow sample accession, submission intake and research data access through controlled laboratory systems and attributable audit records.
pain_points: Instrument results can arrive without the audit evidence needed for release.
Submission intake and review systems have separate acceptance and completion states.
Environmental or storage failures can interrupt data availability without proving data corruption.
regulated_science.stakes: Distinguish operational availability, record completeness and release authorization; none substitutes for the others.
regulated_science.continuity: Hold affected release work for accountable review; retain instrument and audit references for reconciliation.
regulated_science.verification: Compare accession, import, audit-trail association and release records without declaring compliance from a green status.

mission_support.headline: Installation services underpin mission coordination and logistics
mission_support.mission: Connect task dissemination, supply requests and protected collaboration to shared access, integration and installation continuity.
pain_points: Supporting IT can be green while task acknowledgements stall.
A containment boundary can sever logistics exchange needed by another team.
Power, network and access readiness must be checked together at a distributed site.
mission_support.stakes: Explain which support handoffs are interrupted without inventing mission outcomes or exposing operational content.
mission_support.continuity: Keep coordination and logistics owners in the containment review; use only an approved alternate support path.
mission_support.verification: Verify task acknowledgements and requisition reconciliation, plus local power and circuit readiness.

oversight.headline: Evidence must be available, attributable and complete
oversight.mission: Follow case intake, evidence review and publication through document repositories, identity and accountable review workflows.
pain_points: Collecting documents does not establish completeness or provenance.
A search index can be healthy while source records are unavailable.
Publication readiness requires review and retention evidence, not only successful uploads.

processes.outcome: Cases accepted into the review queue

oversight.stakes: Help reviewers distinguish an inaccessible record from an absent record and retain the evidence available at decision time.
oversight.continuity: Defer conclusions dependent on unavailable records; retain manifests and ownership for follow-up.
oversight.verification: Reconcile expected and retrieved manifests and review access/audit records before asserting sufficiency.

legislative.headline: Session delivery, preservation and public access share infrastructure
legislative.mission: Connect live session publishing, digital preservation and public catalogue access to their distinct completion records.
pain_points: A live encoder can be healthy while public delivery fails.
An archive copy is not verified until fixity checks complete.
Catalogue availability does not prove that the requested digital object can be delivered.
legislative.stakes: Show delivery, preservation and access as separate operational commitments rather than a single availability light.
legislative.continuity: Use reviewed publishing continuity and retain unverified archive jobs for reconciliation.
legislative.verification: Confirm an external delivery probe, repository ingestion and matching fixity manifests.

global_services.headline: A global service depends on the last mile at each location
global_services.mission: Connect public appointments, protected collaboration and overseas coordination across local circuits and central service dependencies.
pain_points: A central service can be healthy while a remote post cannot reach it.
Partner acknowledgements span time zones and organizational owners.
A local continuity route must be tested before a cutover decision.
global_services.stakes: Separate a shared application problem from a remote-site access problem before redirecting limited support capacity.
global_services.continuity: Validate the alternate route and local operating procedure with the remote site owner.
global_services.verification: Compare central and remote probes using the same case reference and verify a complete handoff.

critical_infrastructure.headline: Operational visibility must respect the control boundary
critical_infrastructure.mission: Follow service dispatch, work-order acknowledgement and maintenance evidence through supporting IT and OT information services.
pain_points: Historian data freshness can fail independently of physical service delivery.
IT containment can remove the remote support path used by operations.
Maintenance and site evidence must be joined without automatically changing control equipment.
critical_infrastructure.stakes: Keep data-availability conclusions separate from physical asset condition or control-system safety.
critical_infrastructure.continuity: Coordinate operations before isolating support interfaces; apply the approved local operating procedure.
critical_infrastructure.verification: Verify source timestamp, dispatch acknowledgement and independent asset evidence without issuing OT commands.

retail.headline: Successful checkout must become an acknowledged fulfillment order
retail.mission: Connect storefront checkout, order allocation and store transactions so teams can see where a purchase stops progressing.
pain_points: A storefront can be reachable while checkout token exchange times out.
An order accepted by commerce can remain unacknowledged by fulfillment.
Store connectivity and payment or inventory partners can fail independently.
retail.stakes: Separate attempted checkouts, accepted orders and fulfilled orders; queue entries do not establish lost revenue.
retail.continuity: Preserve idempotency keys and reconcile accepted orders before replaying failed acknowledgements.
retail.verification: Match order references across storefront and OMS and verify a store sync independently.

manufacturing.headline: Production is not ready to ship until quality release arrives
manufacturing.mission: Follow production dispatch, quality sign-off and shipment acknowledgement across manufacturing execution and enterprise systems.
pain_points: A production order can be dispatched while the quality-release handoff is blocked.
ERP and MES state can diverge even with healthy server resources.
Isolation of an integration gateway can disrupt the digital thread without stopping a machine.
manufacturing.stakes: Acknowledge production and release records before claiming the manufacturing workflow has recovered.
manufacturing.continuity: Keep unverified lots in the quality workflow; plant control and machine changes remain outside this app.
manufacturing.verification: Reconcile work-order, lot-release and shipment references with the accountable systems.

logistics.headline: A pick is not a delivery: expose the handoffs in between
logistics.mission: Connect warehouse picks, dispatch acceptance and delivery events across WMS, TMS and partner tracking feeds.
pain_points: Warehouse completion can conceal an unacknowledged dispatch manifest.
Carrier visibility depends on event time, location and a shared shipment reference.
Depot connectivity can interrupt scanner and proof-of-delivery uploads.
logistics.stakes: Distinguish a physical shipment delay from a delayed or missing visibility event.
logistics.continuity: Retain manifests and use the reviewed depot fallback; reconcile duplicate carrier events before replay.
logistics.verification: Join pick, manifest and delivery events by shipment reference and compare event time with receipt time.

financial_services.headline: An accepted payment still needs an acknowledged outcome
financial_services.mission: Follow digital banking, payment acknowledgement and fraud-review handoffs across access, transaction and messaging systems.
pain_points: Customer access, message acceptance and settlement are different operational states.
Retries without idempotency evidence can create reconciliation work.
Fraud review and containment must account for payment-service continuity.
financial_services.stakes: Acknowledgement is not settlement; this evidence neither values losses nor establishes the final financial outcome.
financial_services.continuity: Review unresolved payment references before replay and include risk operations in containment decisions.
financial_services.verification: Reconcile message IDs, acknowledgements and final journal outcomes using the approved payment procedure.

technology.headline: Customer journeys expose failures that resource dashboards miss
technology.mission: Connect customer sign-in, API requests and support webhooks to the deployment, identity and regional services behind them.
pain_points: Healthy CPU and memory do not prove that customer requests succeed.
Aggregate latency can conceal errors limited to one shared dependency.
A release timestamp is a correlation clue, not a root-cause conclusion.
technology.stakes: Use request outcomes and dependency diagnostics to focus an incident while preserving contrary evidence.
technology.continuity: Validate canary or standby capacity and preserve trace and idempotency keys before a route change.
technology.verification: Compare end-to-end request probes, API outcomes and independent database/ingress metrics.

commercial_property.headline: Occupied-building operations need digital and physical evidence
commercial_property.mission: Connect tenant requests, building work orders and workplace access while keeping equipment diagnostics visible to facilities teams.
pain_points: A building platform can be online while equipment faults and comfort complaints accumulate.
A missing access heartbeat is an evidence gap, not proof that doors are secure.
Maintenance prioritization needs occupant impact and equipment context.
commercial_property.stakes: Show the occupant-facing work queue beside equipment and telemetry conditions without operating building controls.
commercial_property.continuity: Coordinate the property procedure and verify alternate capacity before transferring digital workloads.
commercial_property.verification: Confirm fresh BMS trends, equipment feedback, work-order acknowledgement and independent occupied-space checks.

hospitality.headline: A reservation should reach the property and complete check-in
hospitality.mission: Follow booking acknowledgement, property check-in and guest-service handoffs across reservation, PMS and interface systems.
pain_points: A reservation can exist centrally while the property interface has not received it.
Check-in completion depends on payment and room-status handoffs.
Local continuity is needed when a property loses its shared-service path.
hospitality.stakes: Separate booking acceptance from property acknowledgement and completed check-in; do not infer revenue loss.
hospitality.continuity: Use the reviewed property downtime process and reconcile central/property reservation references before replay.
hospitality.verification: Match reservation acknowledgements, room-status updates and a completed test check-in with property staff.

interoperability.title: Interoperability and authorization workflows
interoperability.relevance: API-based exchange and reducing administrative handoffs motivate visibility into request completion, acknowledgements and exceptions.

healthcare_resilience.title: Healthcare resilience practices
healthcare_resilience.relevance: Asset inventories, incident planning and third-party dependencies support a joint clinical, security and continuity view.

modernization.title: Legacy-system modernization findings
modernization.relevance: Migration planning, aging dependencies and distributed locally managed systems motivate site-readiness and transition evidence.

laboratory.title: Laboratory data-integrity guidance
laboratory.relevance: Reliable records and audit trails motivate monitoring the completeness and provenance of laboratory workflows.

manufacturing.title: Manufacturing digital thread
manufacturing.relevance: Information exchange between engineering, manufacturing and quality motivates visibility into work-order and release handoffs.

traceability.title: Supply-chain event visibility
traceability.relevance: Business-step, location and event-time context connects warehouse, dispatch and delivery observations.

payments.title: Payment exception resolution
payments.relevance: Payment messages, exception cases and inter-institution coordination motivate acknowledgement and exception-age views.

buildings.title: Building fault detection and prioritization
buildings.relevance: Equipment health, occupant comfort and limited maintenance capacity belong in the same prioritization decision.

reliability.title: Service reliability and diagnostic signals
reliability.relevance: Latency, traffic, errors and saturation distinguish user-visible symptoms from component diagnostics.

identity.title: Identity sign-in and audit evidence
identity.relevance: Sign-in outcomes, application identity and correlation IDs can narrow an access investigation.

hospitality.title: Property business events
hospitality.relevance: Reservation updates and time-sensitive check-in events motivate visibility across property interfaces.

preservation.title: Digital preservation and fixity
preservation.relevance: Checksum comparisons, inventory and retained integrity logs motivate preservation-job completeness and exception review.

audit.title: Evidence sufficiency in assurance work
audit.relevance: Sufficient, appropriate evidence motivates provenance, freshness and completeness checks rather than treating collection alone as assurance.

ot_inventory.title: Operational technology inventory guidance
ot_inventory.relevance: Inventory and criticality context motivate investigation boundaries around operational equipment and its supporting services.
